products.title: Head Vibe Gr Or 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD VIBE GR OR 2026 - Beginner-intermediate range to seek more control and smoothness in hitting for perfect learning. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD VIBE GR OR 2026, an ideal racket to enjoy from the first days on a padel court. Designed to guarantee a wide sweet spot thanks to its teardrop format.

PLAYER TYPE

The ideal level of player for her is a beginner or even intermediate player who is starting out and looking for a durable and comfortable racket, without having to spend a lot of money but with the reliability that will last a long time.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Head Padel is quality, and the HEAD VIBE GR OR 2026 is a super resistant racket suitable for starting to play or continuing to progress.

It has technologies that work great, such as the INNEGRA system, which together with the Foam rubber, reduces all vibrations after hitting.

In the frame, it has a protector integrated inside, it is not visible from the outside. This guarantees better protection against possible blows during the game.

products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.

products.title: Siux Electra Pro Fire Red 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX ELECTRA PRO FIRE RED 2026 - Stupa's new companion for the 2026 season. A renewed padel racket, with a clean design where red stands out around the frame. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

At Pádel Ibérico we bring you the best products from the most important brands on the market. One of these is the SIUX ELECTRA PRO FIRE RED 2026, the new professional racket in the collection, worn by none other than Franco Stupaczuk. A shovel of weapons to take, powerful, with good control and with a very Premium design.

PLAYER TYPE

The SIUX ELECTRA PRO FIRE RED 2026 is an advanced-professional racket, for a demanding player who wants everything in a racket, who can feel power and control at every moment they require it.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX ELECTRA PRO FIRE RED 2026 stands out for its 12K carbon fiber construction and an EVA core. This combination is perfect, offering a firm, precise and very stable hitting sensation.

It is a teardrop-shaped racket and its balanced balance provides great handling. It is a racket that will facilitate our transitions from the bottom to the net.

The surface incorporates a rough matte sandpaper-like finish, designed for players looking to add greater spin to the ball. It is a very effective rough, one of the most notable in its category.

For greater reinforcement, it incorporates a protector integrated into the frame, which will be great for extending the useful life of the racket.

products.title: Enebe Space 2.0 2026 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE SPACE 2.0 2026 - Made with 12K carbon on the faces and a Black EVA Pro core, the Space 2.0 stands out for its firm and dry feel, ideal for responding forcefully INTRODUCTION OF THE RACKET

The ENEBE SPACE 2.0 2026 returns in its 2026 version as a more powerful and aggressive racket, with a teardrop format and top-level 12K carbon. With a modern and daring design in blue tones, this racket attracts attention both for its aesthetics and for its behavior on the court.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a racket that is designed for advanced or professional players who prefer an offensive game, with powerful hits, but who also value effective control in transitions.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

The ENEBE SPACE 2.0 2026 is a hybrid-teardrop format racket, with a large and very comfortable hitting surface to increase control. It has been made with 12K carbon on the faces and a Black EVA Pro core, which stands out for its firm and dry feel, ideal for responding forcefully.

The reinforced carbon structure provides resistance to wear and extra rigidity that helps transfer all the energy of the arm directly to the ball. All this in a mold that offers good ball output and an immediate response in demanding moments.
